summary: [Square Inventory] polling: batchRetrieveInventoryChanges with occurred-at windows + cursor pagination is the primary sync primitive (ledger replay); batchRetrieveInventoryCounts for point-in-time snapshots per location. Watermark = occurred_at cursor over the change ledger. Polling cadence modest; dynamic rate limiting punishes aggression. Reconcile counts from the ledger, never trust a cached number.
